children: Salesforce (CRM, Financials) is said to have initiated another wave of layoffs, fueling fears of job cuts at the enterprise software firm.
Employees discussed the recent job layoffs through an internal Slack channel, according to business records and conversations Business Insider revealed Wednesday.
The overall number of affected employees is not yet known, and Salesforce did not immediately reply to a request for comment.

Shares of the business helmed by Marc Benioff fell about 1% in Wednesday's premarket trade. The new layoffs come on the heels of earlier job cuts as Salesforce tries to streamline its business and investments.
The business is growing its artificial intelligence products, but is facing challenges about how much it costs and how profitable enterprise AI adoption will be.
Further staff cuts might minimize operational expenditures, but the financial effect would depend on the number of jobs terminated and any accompanying restructuring charges.
There is no announced layoff figure, so investors don't have a good read on the current cuts.

Investors will be looking for a formal announcement from the firm and for further clarity on which departments will be impacted and the next earnings report from management to assess the impact on operational expenses and business performance.

title: Salesforce Makes Major Workforce Move After Stock Crashes 9%
